scenes.scene_title: The Reveal // Brand & Hardware Lab Hook

cinematography.camera_movement: Slow smooth dolly-in towards display center at constant low velocity

subject.primary: High-end matte OLED studio display on minimalist obsidian desk
subject.screen_content: BuildLab hero landing page with luminous bold text 'BUILD LAB', 3D PC chassis graphic, and dual mode cards

screen_preservation.instruction: All on-screen typography, 'BUILD LAB' title, buttons, and layout must remain 100% static and razor-sharp with zero text mutation or hallucination

context.lighting: Deep moody dark atmosphere with soft crimson edge rim glow accenting the monitor bezel

style_and_ambiance.color_grading: Deep blacks, crimson red accents, rich contrast

audio.effects: Deep cinematic bass boom on reveal
audio.voiceover: Welcome to the future of computer hardware servicing and architecture.

scenes.negative_prompt: text morphing, changing letters, alien glyphs, melting buttons, shifting UI, camera shake, pixel noise, deformed monitor bezel

cinematography.camera_movement: Gentle horizontal tracking glide from left to right across monitor workspace
cinematography.lens: 50mm prime with shallow depth of field on background only

subject.primary: Studio monitor showcasing the BuildLab 3D Virtual Assembly Studio
subject.screen_content: Fully assembled gaming PC inside tempered glass case on workbench grid with motherboard, cooler, RAM, and GPU

screen_preservation.instruction: The 3D PC model, component names, inventory sidebar, and UI pills must remain rock-solid with zero melting or warping

context.lighting: Crisp white studio key lighting with soft volumetric reflection on the monitor rim

style_and_ambiance.color_grading: Neutral clean tones, tempered glass reflections, studio rim light

audio.ambient: Quiet server room hum, subtle cooling fan breeze
audio.voiceover: Full 3D component simulation. Assemble every part before touching real silicon.

scenes.negative_prompt: UI deformation, morphed parts, changing interface text, flickering canvas, distorted chassis, warped 3D mesh

cinematography.camera_movement: Slow deliberate push-in with gentle upward tilt towards status header
cinematography.lens: 65mm macro lens with sharp planar focus across the screen

subject.primary: Monitor displaying BuildLab Real-Time Compatibility Engine
subject.screen_content: Green 'HARDWARE VERIFICATION COMPLETE' banner, wattage calculations, and side-by-side component matrices

screen_preservation.instruction: Keep all wattage text numbers, hardware specs, checkmarks, and table headers exactly legible without distortion

context.lighting: Deep dark navy ambient with vivid green validation accent light

style_and_ambiance.color_grading: Deep slate navy, punchy emerald green verification accents

audio.effects: Subtle diagnostic chime, high-frequency verification beep
audio.voiceover: Real-time diagnostic validation. Socket matching, power budgeting, and zero conflicts.

scenes.negative_prompt: scrambled numbers, text morphing, illegible tables, melting badges, altered logos, blurred data
